justification: The garden tends itself, mostly. Mr. Olave's patch has gone quiet this week — no fixture at all, which is a different thing entirely from a bad one — and a wizard does not leave a bed empty out of sentiment when something else is ready to bloom; Parker Washington steps into that row the same unhurried way Daniels once did for a byed Goff. Pickens carries his Questionable tag into Dallas, but I see no storm in that forecast, only a label, so he keeps his place. Everyone else stays precisely where the season has already decided they belong — Taylor, Wilson, Barner, Wilson again, Shrader, Denver — not because the parchment insists, but because nothing this week has asked me to disturb them. The rest, as ever, is patience.
